build_Parta2_detector: build a PartA2 3D detector with voxel encoder, middle encoder, and backbone for point cloud detection
extract_feat_Parta2: extract features from point cloud data using voxelization and middle encoder in PartA2 detector
voxelize_points_Parta2: apply hard voxelization to convert raw point clouds into voxel grids with coordinates and centers
forward_train_Parta2: run the PartA2 training forward pass computing RPN and ROI head losses from point cloud data
simple_test_Parta2: run inference on point cloud data with the PartA2 detector to generate 3D bounding box predictions
